announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealing follows the November completion of a transaction. Shareholders should monitor for further insider activity.

announcements.headline: Completion of transaction and appointment of NED
announcements.insight: Following the October restoration of trading and November General Meeting results, Built Cybernetics plc has appointed a new NED. This board change follows the recent capital raise and corporate restructuring.

announcements.headline: Result of General Meeting
announcements.insight: The GM result follows the October capital raise. Shareholders should monitor subsequent regulatory filings for further corporate actions.

announcements.headline: Publication of Circular and Notice of GM
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics plc circulates documents for a general meeting following its October capital raise. Shareholders should review the circular to understand the next steps in this funding process.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Built Cybernetics Plc
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics Plc is proceeding with a fundraise and acquisition following its earlier Capital Access Window. The restoration of trading confirms the completion of these capital raising activities.

announcements.headline: Result of Retail Offer and Restoration of Trading
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics plc completes its October capital raise, following the initial placing and subscription results. This finalizes the funding round announced earlier in the month.

announcements.headline: WRAP Retail Offer
announcements.insight: This retail offer follows the October fundraise, indicating a continued capital raising effort. Shareholders should monitor for further dilution or completion of these capital access steps.

announcements.headline: Result of Placing and Subscription
announcements.insight: This fundraise follows the October acquisition announcement. Shareholders should monitor dilution from this capital raising.

announcements.headline: Acquisition and Fundraise
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics plc pursues an acquisition alongside a fundraise. This follows its September capital access window, indicating continued strategic expansion efforts.

announcements.headline: Capital Access Window - Built Cybernetics PLC
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics plc has entered a Capital Access Window following its September partial disposal. Shareholders should monitor for subsequent funding terms.

announcements.headline: Partial disposal of Aukett + Heese Frankfurt GmbH
announcements.insight: Built Cybernetics plc disposes of Aukett + Heese Frankfurt GmbH. This partial disposal represents a material asset sale for shareholders.
